title: JEV Q5 score-gap experiment run artifact
description: One API scoring run for the preregistered Q5 experiment. Store only in a restricted audit area. Do not record answer text, credentials, secrets, or answer-bearing error details in this artifact or its referenced logs. This artifact must never be written to the assessment production database.

runId.description: Unique run identifier; opaque identifier only.

realId.description: Provider-reported real model ID; null if the run failed before a provider response.

alias.description: Configured model alias for this run.

comparisonMode.description: One scoring condition only; this run does not compare a baseline with a candidate.

conditionId.description: Opaque ID of the single scoring condition evaluated by this run.

datasetId.description: Opaque ID of the fixed anonymous answer dataset.

manifestReference.description: Opaque reference to the restricted dataset manifest; do not include answer text or real submission IDs.

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the frozen manifest containing only anonymous IDs and revisions, not answer text or real IDs.

anonymousId.description: Stable opaque anonymous answer ID reused across runs; must not encode participant identity, real submission ID, or answer text.

revision.description: Source revision: the original submission revision or synthetic fixture revision, not a run/replicate counter.

keyId.description: Opaque identifier for the protected HMAC key; never include key material.

digest.description: HMAC-SHA-256 of the exact canonical answer input payload, excluding credentials.

inputFingerprint.description: Keyed fingerprint prevents dictionary guessing of short answers. The key must be held outside the artifact in a protected store.

timeBlock.description: Preregistered time-block ID used for paired comparison.

order.description: Randomized execution order within the preregistered schedule.

replicateIndex.description: Planned repeat index for this answer and single scoring condition; distinct from attempts, which counts API requests within this run.

reference.description: Opaque restricted-store reference to non-answer request/config snapshot; do not inline request text or secrets.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the referenced canonical non-answer configuration snapshot, with answer input and credentials excluded.

probabilities.description: Provider probabilities for the 0/1/2 score classes; all three are null when the response did not provide probabilities.

rawScore.description: Provider raw score in [0,2], or null when unavailable.

currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code when amount is known; use XXX when unknown.

reference.description: Opaque restricted-store reference to provider response; null if no response was returned. Do not inline response body or secrets.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the referenced response snapshot, with secrets removed; null if no response was returned.
